negative_reviews.author: Kilmaa
negative_reviews.text:
★★★☆☆ 3/5 — Great drinks, so-so mains

Went here for dinner with my wife, friend and his misses  — a lively spot with a good soundtrack (props for the Feel Good Inc and Promiscuous throwback) and a fun greeting on arrival with a big drum bong. Good energy from the start.

The cocktails genuinely stole the show. My wife's rose cocktail came out in a rose-shaped glass with a smoky liquid nitrogen effect — properly impressive presentation. The Hanami was more understated but the flavour more than made up for the simpler glass. Easily 10/10 on drinks.

The sushi held up its end too — fresh, bright, well-made rolls with nothing to fault (8.5/10).

The kitchen was the weak link, though. The chashu yakisoba had well-cooked, al dente noodles, but the sauce leaned sweet with little else going on. The Steak Tataki Ramen was the bigger letdown — the beef was bland and the broth underwhelming, especially at that price point. The chashu pork itself was genuinely great, just surrounded by dishes that didn't back it up.

Service was attentive and friendly throughout (8/10).

Overall: come for the drinks and sushi, don't expect much from the ramen. £82 for two felt steep given the food didn't match the price.
